S015.1 (L1–L5): The page concludes with Centr_pi(pi-prime) = {1}, then states a corollary about the centralizer of an open subgroup in a profinite group given as a successive extension of free profinite groups. This records the manuscript’s assertion without repairing its hypotheses.

S015.2 (L6–L14): The proof reduces to a free profinite group, inserts that pi-prime is free, assumes pi-prime invariant, and invokes two admitted assertions: trivial center and absence of nonidentity finite-order elements. Both admissions carry an explicit à vérifier in the left margin. The writer uses the injection of the centralizer into pi/pi-prime in the argument. This is a description of the source, not an independent verification.

S015.3 (L15–L20): The Scholie revises sans torsion to à centre and discusses recovering the groupoid, or the associated topos wording as actually written, from the exterior group attached to E_{bar K/K}. It changes a cancelled phrase to défini à isom, while unique près remains ordinary main-line text. The page ends with Les hom.

S015.check1 (main-reader targeted counterexample): as written without a rank or nonabelian restriction, the Corollaire includes the free profinite group F on one generator, taking the open subgroup to be F itself. Every finite quotient of F is cyclic, so F is abelian; the defining universal property supplies a quotient of order two, so F is nontrivial. Hence C_F(F)=F is not {1}. The assertion that a free profinite group has trivial centre cannot hold in this generality. This is a check of the literal unrestricted statement, not a claim about a more restricted geometric situation that the author may have intended. The source wording and its two à vérifier notes remain unchanged.

S015.check2 (conditional refinement, checked): if G is torsion-free and has a normal subgroup U of finite index with Z(U)={1}, then C_G(U)={1}. Indeed C_G(U) injects into G/U by the kernel computation C_G(U) intersect U=Z(U), so it is finite; a torsion-free group has no nontrivial finite subgroup. This isolates the two premises needed by the written final argument without asserting that the manuscript has established them. No unprinted rank hypothesis has been inserted.

Independent audit: all14 differing boxes and36 token spans personally inspected. Four boxes change: le/les and correction-state uncertainty; cancelled sans resolved; punctuation and abbreviation ambiguity in the cancelled torsion run; expanded uncertainty in the cancelled phrase and replacement defini/definie. The centralizer symbol is distinct from its leader, and ou/où le topos B_K remains the supported inserted phrase. No new mathematical check was performed during this reading audit.
